BL-872 — DEFECT — BL-459's cleanup-trap lock rotted: 18 files under swarmforge/scripts create temp roots with no cleanup (one of them the production pre-QA gate lib), because the guard's real-tree assertion lives in a directory no standing gate runs
What it solves: The acceptance contract ships as `.feature.draft` (BL-233): its step handlers
do not exist yet, and a live `*.feature` with no handlers makes the acceptance
runner throw. The coder renames it to `.feature` and updates this ticket's
`acceptance:` field in the same parcel that lands the handlers.
Approval context: New feature draft needs review, plus two deliberate calls to sign off or overturn. (1) This ticket carries BOTH halves — remediating the 18 violating files AND giving the guard a standing home — in one slice, on the grounds that shipping only the remediation guarantees a third round of the same rot…
BL-872 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-872" (or "reject BL-872 <reason>") to act.
